field.name: NRST_MDSEL[1:0]
field.description: NRST pin mode selection. 00: Reserved 01: A low level on the NRST pin can reset system, internal reset can not drive NRST pin. 10: NRST pin function as normal GPIO, and only internal RESET. 11: NRST pin configure as input/output mode.

field.name: nBOOT0
field.description: BOOT0 option bit 0: BOOT0 is 1 1: BOOT0 is 0

field.name: nBOOT1
field.description: BOOT1 option bit 0: BOOT1 is 1 1: BOOT1 is 0 Together with the BOOT0 pin, this bit selects boot mode

field.name: SWBT0
field.description: Software BOOT0 0: BOOT0 taken from PA14/BOOT0 pin 1: BOOT0 taken from the option bit nBOOT0

field.name: MLT_BND_SEC_EN
field.description: Multiple-bonding security enable 0: Disable 1: Enable When this bit is set, a automatic I/O configuration mechanism is enabled,which can prevent conflicts on I/Os connected (bonded) onto the same pin. If one of the I/Os connected to the same pin is set as active by configuring the SYSCFG_CFG3 register,and this bit is set ( multiple-bonding security enabled ), then the mechanism will automatically force the other I/Os in digital input mode, regardless of their software configuration.And when this bit is reset ( multiple-bonding security disabled ),the setting of SYSCFG_CFG3 register will be ignored, and GPIOs' mode linked to a given pin can be set according to GPIOs configuration.

field.name: SRAM_PARITY_CHECK
field.description: SRAM parity check disable 0: SRAM parity check enable 1: SRAM parity check disable

field.name: nWWDG_HW
field.description: Window watchdog configuration bit 0: Hardware window watchdog 1: Software window watchdog

field.name: nFWDG_HW
field.description: Free watchdog configuration bit 0: Hardware free watchdog 1: Software free watchdog

field.name: nRST_DPSLP
field.description: Option byte deepsleep reset value 0: Generates a reset if entering deepsleep mode 1: No reset if entering deepsleep mode

field.name: BOR_TH[1:0]
field.brief: BOR threshold at falling VDD supply
field.description: BOR threshold at falling VDD supply VDD brownout crossings this threshold activates the reset signal. 00: BOR level 1(falling threshold is 2.1 V / rising threshold is 2.0 V) 01: BOR level 2(falling threshold is 2.3 V / rising threshold is 2.2 V) 10: BOR level 3(falling threshold is 2.6 V / rising threshold is 2.5 V) 11: BOR level 4(falling threshold is 2.9 V / rising threshold is 2.8 V)

field.name: BORST_EN
field.description: Brownout reset enable 0: Brown out reset disable, power-on reset defined by POR/PDR levels 1: Brown out reset enable, values of BOR_TH taken into account

field.name: SPC[7:0]
field.brief: Security protection level option byte status bits
field.description: Security protection level option byte status bits 0xA5: No protection 0xCC: Protection level high, chip read protection enabled Any value except 0xA5 or 0xCC: Protection level low, memory read protection enabled

field.name: DCRP0_SADDR[5:0]
field.description: DCRP area 0 start address DCRP0_SADDR contains the offset of the first subpage of the DCRP area 0.

field.name: DCRP_EREN
field.brief: DCRP area erase enable configuration bit
field.description: DCRP area erase enable configuration bit. 0: DCRP is not erased when SPC value in FMC_OBCTL register is decreased from value 1 to value 0. 1: DCRP is erased when SPC value in FMC_OBCTL register is decreased from value 1 to value 0.

field.name: DCRP0_EADDR[5:0]
field.description: DCRP area 0 end address offset DCRP0_EADDR contains the offset of the last subpage of the DCRP area 0.

field.name: WP0_EADDR[5:0]
field.brief: Write protection area 0 end address offset
field.description: Write protection area 0 end address offset WP0_EADDR contains the last page of Write protect area 0.

field.name: WP0_SADDR[5:0]
field.brief: Write protection area 0 end address offset
field.description: Write protection area 0 end address offset WP0_SADDR contains the first page of Write protect area 0.

field.name: WP1_EADDR[5:0]
field.brief: Write protection area 1 end address offset
field.description: Write protection area 1 end address offset WP1_EADDR contains the last page of Write protect area 1

field.name: WP1_SADDR[5:0]
field.brief: Write protection area 1 start address offset
field.description: Write protection area 1 start address offset WP1_SADDR contains the first page of Write protect area 1

field.name: DCRP1_SADDR[5:0]
field.description: DCRP area 1 start address offset DCRP1_SADDR contains the offset of the first subpage of the DCRP area 1

field.name: DCRP1_EADDR[5:0]
field.description: DCRP area 1 end address offset DCRP1_EADDR contains the offset of the last subpage of the DCRP area 1.

field.name: WP_DF[3:0]
field.description: Data flash write protection 0001: Data flash page0 write protect enable 0010: Data flash page1 write protect enable 0100: Data flash page2 write protect enable 1000: Data flash page3 write protect enable

field.name: BOOTLK
field.brief: This bit is set to force boot from user Flash area
field.description: This bit is set to force boot from user Flash area. 0: Support flash, ram and system boot 1: Only boot from main flash

field.name: SCR_PAGE_CNT[6:0]
field.brief: Configure the number of pages in secure user area
field.description: Configure the number of pages in secure user area. Secure user area starts at memory 0x0800 0000.The memory size is SCR_PAGE_CNT * page size.
